translations.en: If they're settling a blood feud, why are they standing there so chummy?
Just as @7rTanya@0r said, the two people who were supposedly about to
avenge a death stood side by side, staring at you
with unnaturally red eyes.
It's a trap!
The instant that thought struck, they changed from people into monsters
and attacked.
Monster
I'll be the one to collect the bounty on your head!
Why did that person turn into a monster?
I don't get it!
@7rTanya@0r could only fluster helplessly.
It seemed you had simply been tricked.
But hadn't the monster that attacked you
said something strange?
There was a bounty on your head...
Did monsters even have such a thing as bounties?
It seemed worth investigating,
but you had no idea where to begin.
Is something bothering you?
If something's bothering you, I think you should ask @7rBeatrix@0r.
As @7rTanya@0r suggested, asking @7rBeatrix@0r would be quickest.
You should return to the tavern in town as soon as possible.
Hey, hey, heeey!
Isn't that an awful lot of nasty-looking faces?
Hand over your cargo and we won't kill you.
Give it here!
Nyah, nyah! If I handed things over just because you told me to,
I'd never make it as a courier!
All right, my trusty bodyguard! You're up!
You really are strong, aren't you?
Keep it up and knock 'em down!
And make my life nice and easy!
Now, let's get this delivery moving!
You're attacking us again?
Will you give it a rest already?!
That's our line.
Just lie down and die. Stop your useless struggling!
As long as we're alive, we'll struggle all we like!
Now, get them!
Still, why are you so desperate to stop us?
You come and go as you please with that ancient seal still intact,
so what's the problem?
@7rFiore@0r had a point.
Why were they so determined to break the seal?
You would have to ask @7rBeatrix@0r later.
You just won't quit!
Don't you know nobody likes a pest?!
Oh, I see... You're ignoring me.
Fine. Whatever gets in our way, I'll just give the word,
and my friend here will smash it to pieces!
We're almost there, so hang in there!
You had arrived right at the site where a mechanism was being assembled
to form a large magic circle on the floor.
The unfinished circle did not yet give off its distinctive glow,
but the mages working there looked utterly serious
as they refined the spellwork.
Good work, everyone!
While you were admiring their work, I finished the delivery.
Thanks for all your hard work!
Once this magic circle is finished, they should be able to keep some track
of what those things are doing.
Where they're gathering,
what they're up to, that sort of thing.
Everyone's doing what they can right now.
We've got to do our part too!
Well, shall we head back?
I'll pay you once we reach the tavern.
The job isn't over until we've made it there and back!
I'm counting on you for the trip home too!
In a patch of dim light,
you spotted a box fixed to the floor. Before it sat a shaggy,
heavily muscled monster.
Its friendly face looked almost comically foolish at first glance,
but if those bulging arms were anything to go by, underestimating it
in a fight would be a mistake you would regret.
Fenodyree
What brings you here?
Unlike its appearance, its voice was intelligent and composed.
I'll ask you again. What brings you here?
